purpose: Describe how any external source can contribute identity, technical evidence, commerce, logistics or procurement to Product Twin without redefining the canonical taxonomy.

source_adapter.name: string
source_adapter.source_type: global_catalog | merchant_storefront | manufacturer | distributor | trade_portal | bim_library | material_library | logistics_provider | other

interfaces.kind: mcp | ucp_mcp | rest | graphql | storefront_web | partner_feed | file_feed | other

principles: A source can be excellent for one graph and weak for another.
MCP or API availability is an interface fact, not evidence that the source contains identity, geometry, rights, local stock, delivery or project-procurement data.
Manufacturer technical truth and commercial availability remain independently versioned.
Authentication requirements are explicit so Product Twin can distinguish public discovery from trade-account procurement.
Physical locations are stored only when they are evidenced as relevant supply/service nodes, not inferred from a corporate headquarters.
